convention_basis: EZ Tools present timestamps in UTC. Evidence in the inspected 2026.10 builds: help texts such as EvtxECmd '--sd Start date for including events (UTC)', MFTECmd '--cutoff ... (UTC unless an offset is given)' and the ISO format string 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffffffZ'. Not yet confirmed against real output on Windows; values are therefore labelled 'tool UTC convention', not 'explicit UTC'.

events.meaning: Shortcut file created (file system time of the .lnk)
Shortcut file modified (file system time of the .lnk)
Target created (as recorded inside the shortcut)
Target modified (as recorded inside the shortcut)
Target accessed (as recorded inside the shortcut)

column_verification: Column names confirmed as property identifiers in LECmd.dll 2026.10.3 (static); a real CSV header from this build has not been observed on the build host.
